page_title: WOL 1-2 IPS | Wolves v Ipswich 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) receives a second yellow card and walks off the field of play!
90+5' That's it for today, Simon Hooper has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Having seen unsporting behavior, Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Liam Delap (Ipswich) is the recipient.
90+4' Jack Taylor (Ipswich) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.

90+4' 1 - 2 Jack Taylor (Ipswich) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Jack Clarke. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:2.
90+4' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) is about to take a corner kick.
90+4' Ipswich get a corner. Leif Davis (Ipswich) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

90+2' Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
87' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Arijanet Muric.

86' Great chance! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
86' A snap shot by Matheus Cunha (Wolves) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Arijanet Muric flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) coming on for Wes Burns.
84' Kieran McKenna has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich) replacing Liam Delap.

84' Goncalo Guedes dinks a lofted pass into the path of Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) inside the box, but his drive sails a whisker past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.

83' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
80' Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.

79' Arijanet Muric is a nightmare for the offensive players! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) meets a cross on the edge of the penalty area, takes a good first touch and fires a rocket of a shot towards the right post, but the goalkeeper produces a wonderful save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolves.
77' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) sends the corner into the box, but Arijanet Muric intercepts it and averts the threat.
76' The referee awards a corner and Thomas Doyle (Wolves) goes over to take it.
76' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
75' It will be a substitution. Jack Taylor (Ipswich) is ready to enter the pitch as Conor Chaplin walks off.
75' Kieran McKenna has decided to substitute Jens Cajuste and he is replaced by Jack Clarke (Ipswich).
75' Simon Hooper interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mario Lemina (Wolves).
72' A substitution has been made. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde is replaced by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves).
72' 1 - 1 Matheus Cunha (Wolves) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball inside the left post.
68' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Arijanet Muric acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save!
67' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
66' The Ipswich players are exchanging some short passes.
64' Here's the change. Matt Doherty leaves the pitch and Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) comes on as a substitute.
62' Harry Clarke (Ipswich) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
62' Matt Doherty (Wolves) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
61' Neat passing move from Wolves in order to create new attacking opportunities.

60' Liam Delap (Ipswich) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches over the bar. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
58' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) picks up an injury.
56' Liam Delap (Ipswich) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
55' Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.
53' Matt Doherty (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but Arijanet Muric comes off his line to gather the ball.
52' Great teamplay by Ipswich as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
48' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Andre is replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
46' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45+1' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' 1:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
41' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Sam Johnstone easily deals with the threat.
39' Ipswich are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
37' Mario Lemina (Wolves) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Arijanet Muric is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
34' Looks like Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

33' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Arijanet Muric easily makes the save.
32' The Wolves players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
30' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
27' Matt Doherty (Wolves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
26' Ipswich control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

24' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) gets on the end of a pass from Mario Lemina inside the box and quickly shoots, but the effort goes inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
23' Good movement by Leif Davis (Ipswich), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
18' Ipswich enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
15' 0 - 1 Matt Doherty (Wolves) scores an unlucky own goal! He deflects a shot into his own net.
14' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
13' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Sam Johnstone.
10' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) serves up a nice cross, but Sam Johnstone punches the ball away.
9' Ipswich failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

8' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Ipswich have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
6' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
5' Matt Doherty (Wolves) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Simon Hooper stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
4' Wolves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Wolves have been awarded a free kick.
1' Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul after Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) hacks down one of his opponents.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Ipswich will have the kick-off.
Simon Hooper is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
